strategy_attacker — DRIVE racket op

• Data kinds: table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.strategy_attacker(side: 'int', ctx: 'dict', rng) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import racket; racket.strategy_attacker(side: 'int', ctx: 'dict', rng) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("strategy_attacker"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

勝つための打ち方: 相手のラケットから遠い隅(左右の端、前後を交互)へ、短い滞空時間で。スピンの狙いも交互に変える。

`ctx` = {"opp_pos" (3,), "shot_index", "tp"}。返り値 {"target" (x, y), "T", "spin"}。
